paper.title: Does Competence Make Citizens Tolerate Undemocratic Behavior?

claims.claim: The study included more than 260,000 candidate observations.
The low endpoint of respondents per country was 2,481.
The high endpoint of respondents per country was 3,159.
The low endpoint of candidate observations per country was 47,221.
The high endpoint of candidate observations per country was 60,106.
The pooled sample had 267,795 candidate observations.
Undemocratic behavior effects ranged down to −0.20.
Undemocratic behavior effects ranged up to −0.06.
A one-unit competence increase had effects of approximately 0.14–0.15; lower endpoint.
A one-unit competence increase had effects of approximately 0.14–0.15; upper endpoint.
Average undemocratic-behavior effects were significant at p < .001 in each country.
Average competence effects were significant at p < .001 in each country.
Differences between average and very competent candidate effects were insignificant in all five countries.
Very incompetent candidates were sanctioned less than average-competence candidates only in the Czech Republic.
In the Czech Republic, the very-incompetent contrast was 0.13 (95% CI 0.05, 0.21; p = .001).

findings.description: Data_prep.do imports five country TSV files from a Windows U: drive, but those raw survey exports are absent from the provided package. The supplied final dataset.dta is present and reproduces the article’s primary reported outputs. The raw-to-final preparation stage could not be executed or translated in full in this run.
findings.evidence: Data_prep.do imports ukmain.tsv, usmain.tsv, mxmain.tsv, skmain.tsv, and czmain.tsv; package contains dataset.dta but none of those TSVs.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide the five original TSVs and a platform-neutral path configuration, then execute and translate the complete preparation stage.

limitations: Only the primary analysis block underlying the article’s reported numerical results was translated and executed; the full 2,755-line Data_prep.do and all auxiliary commands in Analysis.do were not translated. The authors’ final dataset was used as supplied.

R 4.6.1 with sandwich HC1 cluster covariance and cluster-count t reference degrees of freedom was used as the direct translation of Stata respondent-clustered OLS; no Stata executable was available for cross-engine comparison.

provenance.raw_data: Provided package: /tmp/scratch_bench_luna/packages/pkg-984353/dataset.dta; raw country TSV exports referenced by Data_prep.do were not included.
